name: bandit.phase4_visibility_forest_optic_day_live_mcw
description: Phase-4 live clear-day optical forest row on the accepted road-day route. The target-only save transform makes (137,49,0) real forest while preserving the exact terrain-opportunity dispatch, three zombies, approach, and watch; an outing member's binoculars must raise the sight budget to six and cross the target forest screen.

steps.label: post_load_phase4_visibility_forest_optic_day_settle
steps.expected_visible_fact: the clear-day optical forest/horde fixture reaches normal gameplay; this is startup footing only
steps.failure_rule: If gameplay does not load, no live visibility proof can be credited.

steps.label: preflight_phase4_visibility_forest_optic_day_site
steps.abort_reason: saved state did not contain the idle five-member camp and accepted exact terrain-opportunity lead before the visibility run
steps.expected_immediate_state: five ready members and the accepted target route are idle before production dispatch

steps.label: preflight_phase4_visibility_forest_optic_day_horde
steps.abort_reason: saved overmap metadata did not contain three concrete hostile entities on transformed forest target (137,49,0)
steps.expected_immediate_state: three distinct concrete mon_zombie entities occupy transformed forest target (137,49,0) before runtime

steps.label: wait_first_6_hours_toward_phase4_visibility_forest_optic_day_due
steps.pre_menu_expected_visible_fact: alarm/wait mode menu is visible, then Wait a while is chosen before the 6-hour duration menu
steps.expected_visible_fact: six real game hours pass while production owns legacy migration and initializes the exact camp's routine activation clock
steps.failure_rule: If the first bounded wait does not complete, the deterministic 11-hour dispatch window is not reached.

steps.label: wait_second_6_hours_for_phase4_visibility_forest_optic_day_dispatch
steps.pre_menu_expected_visible_fact: alarm/wait mode menu is visible, then Wait a while is chosen before the 6-hour duration menu
steps.expected_visible_fact: the real hourly cadence crosses the accepted due boundary and dispatches an exact pair toward transformed forest target (137,49,0)
steps.failure_rule: If the bounded wait lacks the exact dispatch artifact, the row is red/inconclusive.

steps.label: wait_first_1_hour_for_phase4_visibility_forest_optic_day_approach
steps.pre_menu_expected_visible_fact: alarm/wait mode menu is visible, then Wait a while is chosen before the 1-hour duration menu
steps.expected_visible_fact: the first post-dispatch owner hour reaches the accepted approach OMT without collapsing approach and watch arrival
steps.failure_rule: If the first post-dispatch hour does not reach scheduler hour 156 at minute 9360, the serialized approach transition is red/inconclusive.

steps.label: wait_second_1_hour_for_phase4_visibility_forest_optic_day_observer
steps.pre_menu_expected_visible_fact: alarm/wait mode menu is visible, then Wait a while is chosen before the 1-hour duration menu
steps.expected_visible_fact: the second post-dispatch owner hour reaches exact watch (138,52,0) and runs the clear-day optical visibility read through the transformed forest target
steps.failure_rule: If the second post-dispatch hour lacks visibility at scheduler hour 157 and minute 9420, the row is red/inconclusive.

steps.label: audit_phase4_visibility_forest_optic_day_artifact
steps.abort_reason: same-run debug delta did not prove the exact clear-day optical forest acquisition and concrete threat observation
steps.failure_rule: No clear-day optical row credit if dispatch and exact visibility outcome are not present on same-run lines.

steps.label: audit_phase4_visibility_forest_optic_day_requires_optic
steps.abort_reason: the optical forest fixture produced a no-optic visibility trace
steps.failure_rule: A no-optic trace invalidates this optical forest contrast.

evidence_contract.claim: the accepted exact pair reaches watch (138,52,0), uses an outing member's actual binoculars to derive a six-point clear-day budget, crosses the real forest see cost at transformed target (137,49,0), and observes its three concrete zombies at distance three
evidence_contract.load_only_verdict: load/setup proof only / inconclusive for structural visibility
evidence_contract.failure_rule: No Phase-4 clear-day optical row credit unless startup, accepted terrain-opportunity lead, exact target-only forest transform, exact three-entity target footing, elapsed dispatch, separate approach and watch hours, clear weather, actual optic, six-point budget, distance-three forest acquisition, and observed threat outcome are separately green.
